title: HALO REACH BLOOM
why: His yes to the Halo Reach DMR bloom, adapted to the ring on the cursor. In Reach every shot opens the reticle, it closes again over a short recovery, the next round lands at random inside the reticle as it is now, so a closed reticle is a pinpoint shot and spamming widens the spread: players pace their shots, and the reticle is the honest readout. Every gun now has its own bloom. The semi-autos (pistol, Magnum, Marksman Rifle, Longshot, Burst Carbine, Riot Scattergun, Whisper, Meridian Lance) open wide on one round and close again in about a second, so the fastest trigger finger leaves some bloom on the next round while a beat of patience gives the pinpoint round back. The autos (SMG, Auto Rifle, Support MG) open a hair per round and fill over about two seconds of held fire, which is what a burst is for. The cursor ring grows with the bloom and closes with it, and moving adds to it as before. This is a balance change, which his rule of 2 October allows: the first round after a pause is exactly as accurate as it was, a spammed semi-auto is up to about two and a half times as loose, and the bot raids and the seeded stream are untouched.
now: Every gun blooms its own way: spam a semi-auto and the spread opens, pace your shots and the pinpoint round comes back.
